verdicts.label: TRUE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: India's Chandrayaan-3 mission successfully landed its Vikram lander near the Moon's south pole on August 23, 2023.
verdicts.reasoning_en: Multiple independent news and information sources, including VOA News, PBS.org, Astronomy.com, Time.com, and Wikipedia, all confirm that the Chandrayaan-3's Vikram lander successfully touched down near the Moon's south pole on August 23, 2023. There is no contradictory evidence.

verdicts.label: TRUE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: India became the first country to successfully land a spacecraft in the Moon's south pole region on August 23, 2023.
verdicts.reasoning_en: Multiple news outlets (VOA News, PBS.org, TheGuardian.com) and information sources (Wikipedia, Eoportal.org) explicitly state that India was the first country to land a spacecraft in the Moon's south pole region. This is further supported by a TIER_1 fact-check from BOOM Fact Check, which debunks the claim that another country (China) was the first to achieve this feat. There is no credible evidence contradicting this claim.
